objective: Build the Lantern Express client on the shared UiKit: start menu and panels (album with odds, locker, rewards, board, settings), the HUD and Depot panel, the ping wheel, lamp turret control with the aim sent as a direction, wisp and Lampeater drawing, the fog wall, the train camera and lighting, followers.
acceptance_criteria: Files as architecture section 6; every widget from UiKit; no client file decides an outcome (QA script_grep: only the 0018 actions are sent, and only directions on Aim)

Turret aim: mouse, touch drag and right stick; the direction is converted into the train frame and sent at most 10 times a second; the local beam draws at once; other players' beams follow their turret heads
Wisps and the Lampeater are drawn from Fx spawn records with WispRules.pos and lampeaterPos and puff on the server's Fx; the fog wall follows TrainRules.fogFront's formula from BellAt
Every GDD L line is visible in a Studio recording; no text under 12 px at 844 x 390 (Device Emulator screenshot); Reduced Motion skips animations
The album WHERE tab shows LootRules.odds summing to 100% for every tile
lune run tests/run, selene, stylua --check, validate-tasks and check-scope pass; rojo build lantern.project.json and check-place pass
verification: CI, Studio notes with the build stamp, and the LANTERN-013 QA review
